4.95 Effect Table

All 128 entries of Effect.tbl from the 4.95 client (Nexon/NextAeon/NexusTK.dat), animated at their real frame delays.

Two numbers per card, and they are not the same number. The large orange one is the Effect.tbl index — the art itself, what the client draws. The blue csv one is index + 1: the value you write into the animation column of spell_effects.csv or pass to ctx:fx(), because the client loads the table 1-based and the 0x29 byte N draws entry N−1. Blind carries animation 1 and renders index 0, vex. Spell chips are listed on the card they actually draw.

Ids 117–127 are frameless or absent in the 4.83 assets still sitting in re/fx/, so no earlier matching run could see them.
